findings.title: Unconfirmed Job cleanup releases Source read guards while consumers may remain live
findings.trigger: run_owned returns cleanup with active_processes_last_observed=1, job_idle_confirmed=false, handles_closed=false, or no native result is available after child creation.
findings.observed: Both inner and outer finally call close() unconditionally. Pure exact-AST controls show source_guard.held false while live-child cleanup remains unconfirmed. Canonical lease retention does not retain deny-write/deny-delete source handles.
findings.impact: A still-live child may load or reload phase worker, runner or helper paths after immutable-source protection has been removed; the full reviewed Source tuple is not held through all consumer lifetimes.
findings.basis: Base owned-process helper can return cleanup errors/unconfirmed Job idle after its bounded cleanup deadline, so this is an explicit supported failure path, not a claimed actual native failure.
findings.requested_change: Retain the guard and its owning controller state on every unconfirmed cleanup path. Release only after independently evidenced child-tree termination/Job idle and required handle cleanup, using an explicit bounded recovery/owner-lifetime contract; avoid unconditional outer finally close. Preserve lease and cleanup evidence without automatic retry or renewed trial budget.
findings.proof_scope: Exact finalization AST with memory guard and supplied cleanup states; no real Job, WinAPI, thread or source-file mutation.
